content: Tai dunda zhanlao danlasan kunlade bi sughazhi kielieye. Biyeshi zhanlao wo, Mexiha shouku giekude ganzhen beizhi jianlai khizheku famade hhantu xianshou giechen kun wo.
Tai dundadu Hudai ghonilai qiezhe. Hudai isi mutun hhelai zhaogu gie. Mienqian bu giedene yenyizhe gie. Baerde oluzhi bu giedene bayasuzhi gie.
Tande ogisan ghonilai gofende bu gonjizhi gieku yanzi uzhegha.
Ingiese Zui Fugie Adulachen xienjikude ibeizi ulie qida oluku famatu maghalai tande ogine.
Nasuchighan kunla, taye qingiezhi zhanlaolai shunji. Ta man nieniedene oluzhi goyane meilade uzhekui wiqin danlaghazhi pixilie.

content.text: "Huda goyane undude uzhesan kunlai fandui giene.
Goyane meilade uzhesan kunlade nenjien ogine."

content: Ingiese ta Hudai nenlitu kha doura goyane boghonide uzhe. Shihou kuzhese hhe tai undudaghane.
Ta munan giekulane man Hudade echigha, hhe tai gonjine.
Ta xioxin giezhi jinxin gie. Tai duitou Ibilisi onghonosan shizi mutun eneman hhemanji yozhi ijieku kun ereizho.
Ta xianxin giesan zhughene khiduzheghazhi hhei dui. Duyani gaijiula niekielienji shouku giesei ta mejiene.
Nenjien durusan Huda, Mexihai tungo giezhi tai uruzhi hhei chanqiku famade ireghasan hhe zhanshi jiere shouku giesan tai qinsi hulunshighazhi khiduzheghane, lilian ogizhi undanlaghane.
Qienlini chanqi izhi hhende ogi. Amine!

Bi Seilai tungo giezhi ene okho xinni tande huaiwo. Bi uzhese hheshi nie kekaotu gaijiu wo. Bi xin huaikushi eneshi Hudai zhenzhenji nenjien wo giezhi tande sughazhi kieliezhi ganzhen beine giezho. Ta ene nenjien jiere bei.
Tanre hhantu sunghusan Babilunni jiohui tande kielien asazho. Mii kewon Makeye kielien asazho.
Ta oreku zhugheghala nieniedene kielien asa. Mexihai miende bisan tande man pinnan ogi gie!
